summary:
Qualified Chartered Accountancy professional with hands-on experience in audit, taxation, and financial
reporting. Proven expertise in preparing financial statements, filing GST and income tax returns, and conducting
statutory and internal audits across various sectors including banking, government undertakings, trusts, and
societies. Skilled in regulatory compliance, client coordination, and audit documentation. Strong analytical
acumen with a keen eye for detail and accuracy in financial and tax-related matters.
